Privacy Policy

Effective date: November 2, 2026

Gameday is operated by Sounds Good Team, LLC ("Gameday," "we," "us," or "our"). This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, retain, and protect information when you use the Gameday mobile application, the getgameday.app website, and related services (the "Service").

1. Information We Collect

Account information

Gameday can be used without signing in; the app then uses an anonymous account tied to your device. When you sign in with Apple, we may receive:

  • A unique Apple account identifier.
  • Your name, if you choose to share it (Apple shares it only the first time you sign in).
  • Your email address or Apple private relay email address, if you choose to share it.

We also keep your Gameday user identifier, customer number, account role, and subscription status. Apple does not provide us with your Apple Account password.

Teams, players, and announcements

We collect content you enter into Gameday, including:

  • Team names, colors, ordering, and matchup selections.
  • Player names, numbers, positions, ordering, availability, and play-tracking status.
  • Walkout phrases, pronunciation helpers, voice selections, and the text of generated player introductions.
  • Announcement titles, categories, scripts, favorites, ordering, and voice selections.
  • App settings and preferences, such as audio timing and playback options.

Player information may relate to minors. The adult, coach, parent, team representative, or other person entering that information is responsible for having appropriate authority and consent to do so.

Family Player Profiles and team invites

A coach can invite families to a team with a team code or QR code. When a family member joins, we collect:

  • Which player on the coach's roster the family manages, and which family accounts manage that player (up to four per player).
  • The player's walkout song list: song titles, artists, artwork, catalog identifiers, order, and start points, and whether the list plays in order or shuffled.
  • When the player's walkout last played and which song plays next, recorded by the coach's device so the family can see it.
  • A record of incorrect team codes entered from an account, used only to stop people from guessing codes.

Family members see only their own player, never the rest of the team's roster or batting order. The coach of the player's current team can see the family's song list. A family's profile belongs to the family's account and stays with them if the player moves to another team; the coach can remove a family from their team at any time. Players themselves never need or receive a Gameday account; a parent or guardian manages the profile.

The in-app QR scanner uses your camera only while it is open to read a team code. Camera images are processed on your device and are not stored or sent to us.

Voice-generation information

When you intentionally tap Generate or Regenerate, we process:

  • The text you ask Gameday to convert to speech and the selected synthetic voice.
  • Which player or announcement the audio is for, so that correcting it can be free.
  • Character count, the allowance used, request status, and technical error information.
  • The generated audio file.

To avoid paying to generate the same audio twice, we keep a server-side copy of generated audio identified by a one-way fingerprint (hash) of the text and voice, not by the text itself or by who requested it. If anyone later requests exactly the same text in the same voice, we return the saved audio instead of generating it again. Our generation records store this fingerprint and the character count, not a copy of your text; the text itself remains in your synchronized teams and announcements.

Gameday does not generate speech or use your allowance merely because you edit text, preview an existing recording, or play a locally stored file.

Audio and music information

Gameday may process:

  • Metadata for music you select, such as title, artist, album, duration, and artwork.
  • Local file references needed to find an imported MP3 on your device.
  • Trim points, walkout duration, and other playback settings.
  • Apple Music catalog identifiers and Gameday playlist information.
  • Gameday-provided track selections and download state.

Personal MP3 audio files imported from your device are not uploaded by Gameday to our servers, database, or CloudKit. The audio file remains on your device or in the file location you selected. If that file is moved, deleted, or becomes unavailable, Gameday may ask you to locate it again.

Purchases and subscriptions

When you make a purchase, Apple processes the payment. We and our subscription service provider may receive transaction identifiers, product identifiers, subscription status, renewal state, billing period, expiration information, storefront, and entitlement status. We do not receive your full payment-card information.

Support and feedback

If you contact us or submit feedback, we collect the information you provide, which may include your contact information, message, the app version and build, device model, iOS version, and support history.

TestFlight beta

If you use a TestFlight beta of Gameday, the app sends Apple's signed record of your beta installation to us so we can confirm beta access, and periodically reports the app version and build, device model, iOS version, and when the app was last opened. We also note when an anonymous installation later signs in to your account, so our support team can see your devices.

Website and email sign-up

If you sign up for email updates on getgameday.app, we collect the email address you provide (and any other details the form asks for) to send you news about Gameday. You can unsubscribe at any time using the link in any email.

Our website host processes standard technical information, such as IP addresses and pages requested, to deliver and protect the site.

Technical information

We may receive limited technical information needed to operate and secure the Service, such as request timestamps, app version, device platform, network errors, authentication events, and service logs. Gameday does not use third-party advertising SDKs or cross-app tracking.

Product analytics

To understand how Gameday is used and improve it, the app sends usage events to our analytics provider, PostHog. These record actions such as opening the app, playing a player intro or announcement, generating a voice clip, viewing the subscription screen, starting a subscription, and a family joining a team. Each event may include limited details (such as the type of song source, the announcement category, or the subscription product), your Gameday user identifier, app version, and device information such as model and operating system.

Analytics events do not include player, team, or account names, email addresses, announcement scripts, walkout phrases, or song titles. We do not record your screen, and we configure PostHog to discard IP addresses.

2. How We Use Information

We use information to:

  • Provide, personalize, and maintain Gameday.
  • Synchronize account data across your devices.
  • Connect families to their player's team and play the walkout songs they choose.
  • Generate, cache, and restore synthetic voice recordings you request, and apply your generation allowance.
  • Download and play Gameday-provided audio.
  • Locate and play personal MP3s stored on your device.
  • Provide Apple Music catalog and playback features you choose to connect.
  • Process subscriptions, restore purchases, and apply account entitlements.
  • Run the TestFlight beta program.
  • Send email updates you signed up for.
  • Provide customer support and respond to feedback.
  • Protect users, prevent abuse (such as guessing team codes or excessive generation requests), troubleshoot failures, and secure the Service.
  • Comply with legal obligations and enforce our Terms of Service.

We do not use your team, player, announcement, family profile, or generated voice content to serve advertising.

3. Where Information Is Stored

On your device

Gameday stores an offline copy of app data, generated recordings, downloaded Gameday tracks, and audio references on your device so core playback can continue without a network connection. A coach's device also keeps a copy of the families' walkout lists and songs for their roster so walkouts play offline. Imported personal MP3 files remain local and are not copied to Gameday-operated cloud storage.

Supabase

We use Supabase for authentication and synchronization of structured Gameday data, such as teams, players, announcements, family profiles and walkout lists, team invites, preferences, playlists, entitlements, generation records, and support information. Supabase also stores Gameday-provided tracks and the generation cache described above, and hosts server-side functions used by Gameday.

Apple iCloud and CloudKit

When available and enabled for your account, Gameday may store generated voice recordings in your private CloudKit database so those recordings can be restored on a new device. These files are associated with your private iCloud account and are not placed in a publicly browsable folder. Personal imported MP3 files are not uploaded to CloudKit by Gameday.

4. How We Disclose Information

We disclose information only as needed to operate the Service, comply with law, or complete a transaction you request.

Within a team

When a family joins a team, the team's coach can see the family's walkout song list and which family accounts have joined. The family can see their own player's name, number, position, and team name as entered by the coach, and when the player's walkout last played.

Service providers

Our current service providers include:

  • Apple: Sign in with Apple, CloudKit, Apple Music, App Store purchases, TestFlight, and platform services.
  • Supabase: authentication, database synchronization, storage of Gameday-provided audio and the generation cache, and server-side functions.
  • Render: cloud hosting for Gameday's API (beta access, feedback) and internal administrative services. Authorized Gameday administrators use these services to manage accounts, content, support requests, subscriptions, and business operations.
  • RevenueCat: subscription status, purchase validation, and entitlement management.
  • ElevenLabs: text-to-speech processing for voice generations you explicitly request. Requests go through Gameday's server-side function; the ElevenLabs API credential is not embedded in the app.
  • Cloudflare: hosting and security for the getgameday.app website, and domain name service.
  • Kit: email sign-up and email delivery for people who subscribe to updates on getgameday.app.
  • Fastmail: email for messages you send to Gameday addresses.
  • PostHog: product analytics, as described under "Product analytics."

These providers process information under their own terms and privacy policies and are expected to protect information consistently with applicable law.

Authorized administrative access

Access to customer information is limited to authorized Gameday administrators who require it for customer support, security, account administration, legal compliance, or operation of the Service. We use role-based access and other reasonable safeguards designed to prevent unauthorized administrative access.

Legal and safety disclosures

We may disclose information when reasonably necessary to comply with law, respond to valid legal process, protect the rights or safety of users or others, investigate fraud or abuse, or protect the security of the Service.

Business transfers

If Gameday is involved in a merger, acquisition, financing, reorganization, or sale of assets, information may be transferred as part of that transaction, subject to applicable law and appropriate protections.

5. No Sale, Advertising, or Cross-App Tracking

Gameday does not sell personal information. Gameday does not share personal information for cross-context behavioral advertising and does not track users across apps or websites owned by other companies for advertising purposes.

6. Your Choices and Rights

Depending on where you live, you may have the right to request access, correction, deletion, restriction, portability, or an objection to certain processing of your personal information.

You can:

  • Update much of your team, player, announcement, playlist, and settings data directly in the app.
  • As a family, edit or delete your player's walkout list, leave a team, or delete your player's profile in Player mode's Settings.
  • As a coach, remove a family from your team, turn off your team code, or replace it with a new one.
  • Disconnect Apple Music through Gameday settings or your Apple settings.
  • Manage or cancel subscriptions through your Apple Account subscription settings.
  • Revoke Sign in with Apple access through your Apple Account settings.
  • Unsubscribe from email updates using the link in any email.
  • Delete your Gameday account through the in-app account settings.
  • Contact us at privacy@getgameday.app with a privacy request.

We may need to verify your identity before fulfilling a request.

7. Account Deletion

When you confirm account deletion in Gameday, we initiate deletion of the account and user-owned synchronized data, including teams, players, announcements, playlists, family profiles you created, team invites, generation records, support content, and generated audio under our control. Gameday also requests revocation of the Sign in with Apple authorization associated with the account, asks PostHog to delete the analytics events tied to the account, and removes local app data from the device where deletion was requested.

Audio in the generation cache is not linked to any account and is not removed when an account is deleted. Some information may remain temporarily in encrypted backups, security logs, or records we must retain for legal, fraud-prevention, accounting, or dispute purposes. Apple and other providers may retain transaction records according to their own legal obligations and policies.

Deleting Gameday does not automatically cancel an App Store subscription. You must manage cancellation through your Apple Account subscription settings.

8. Data Retention

We retain account and app content while your account is active and as needed to provide the Service. We retain support, security, transaction, and generation records only as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes described in this policy, including legal, accounting, fraud-prevention, and dispute-resolution needs. We keep email sign-up information until you unsubscribe or ask us to delete it. When information is no longer needed, we delete or de-identify it in accordance with applicable law and our operational backup cycles.

9. Security

We use administrative, technical, and organizational safeguards designed to protect information. These include authenticated access, row-level database security (for example, families can read only their own player's information), private CloudKit storage, encrypted network transport, limits on team-code guessing, and server-side protection of service credentials. No storage or transmission method is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.

10. Children

Gameday is intended for adults, coaches, parents, team representatives, and other authorized users. It is not directed to children under 13, and children under 13 may not create their own Gameday account. Family Player Profiles are managed by a parent or guardian's account; players do not need or receive their own accounts.

Adults may enter limited player information for a team, including information about minors, only when they have the authority and any consent required by applicable law or team policy. Please avoid entering information that is not needed to operate the team and its audio cues. If you believe a child provided personal information directly to us without appropriate authorization, contact us at privacy@getgameday.app.

11. International Processing

Gameday and its service providers may process information in countries other than the country where you live. Where required, we use appropriate safeguards for international transfers and process information in accordance with applicable data-protection law.

12. Third-Party Services

Apple Music, iCloud, the App Store, TestFlight, and other third-party services are governed by their own terms and privacy practices. Their availability and behavior may depend on your account, subscription, region, device, and network connection.

13. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy as Gameday changes. We will update the effective date and provide additional notice when required by law. Your continued use of the Service after an update is subject to the revised policy.
